criteria.requirement: Add Query.at_path(segments), appending a nonempty finite iterable of string keys to the current query path. Treat dots, slashes, empty strings and names of Query methods as literal keys. Preserve Query subclasses, immutability of the original builder, full-path cache identity and uncacheable map paths. Reject plain string/bytes inputs and nonstring segments before returning a query; preserve missing-path false behavior.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
